description:
This protocol performs a sample consolidation from .csv file. The file should be organized in the following way including header line:
Plate Position,Source Well ID,Destination Tube ID,Volume,,
1,A1,A1,3.0,,
1,B1,A1,4.0,,
1,C1,B1,5.0,,
1,D1,A1,3.0,,
...
Empty lines are ignored. You can download a template file here.
The destination tube for all sources will be a specified location (A1-D6) of the custom tuberack in slot 9.



Abgene 96-Well Microplates 330µl (ThermoFisher #AB0796)
Axygen™ 96-well PCR Microplates, barcoded 200µl #14-222-327
Abgene™ 96 Well 2.2mL Polypropylene Deepwell Storage Plate
Opentrons P20 GEN2 single-channel electronic pipette
Opentrons 20µl tipracks
VWR 5ml tubes seated in Opentrons 3x5 tuberack
